text:
Harper (People Ops): FYI we're publishing a short handbook clarification for benefits enrollment exceptions (missed deadlines, new hires outside window) plus a 20-min manager attestation microtraining next Wed. please read the draft and RSVP here: https://sheets.redwood.ai/s/enrollment-exceptions :spiral_note_pad:

Jon (Benefits): TL;DR: no change to core eligibility. this is process-only: how managers attest to exceptions, timing, and docs we accept.

Maya (People Ops): two quick sessions: Wed 09:00 PT and Thu 15:30 PT. managers who approve enrollment exceptions must attend one live or watch recording and confirm via the attestation form.

Rae (Payroll): payroll needs a stable CSV to ingest exception approvals. please use exact headers below so we can automate refunds/adjustments:

```
employee_id, employee_email, exception_reason, enrollment_window, benefits_plan_id, manager_attested (Y/N), attestation_ts, docs_provided (Y/N), payroll_action
```

Noah (Manager): question: if an IC is hired during open enrollment but missed the window due to onboarding delay, can I approve retro enrollment for the current plan year?

Jon (Benefits): yes, if manager attests and documentation shows onboarding delay. retro enrollments limited to 30 days from hire date and require payroll processing flag. we'll add examples in the draft.

Harper (People Ops): action items: 1) managers add headcount to RSVP by EOD Mon; 2) Jon to add three example scenarios in the handbook appendix; 3) Rae to confirm CSV ingest schedule; 4) Harper to publish 1-slide FAQ and 90s TL;DR clip after sessions.

Maya (People Ops): small compliance note: HR/legal asked that attestation include a short sentence from the manager confirming they reviewed the docs. we'll link the attestation form that captures this.

people-ops-bot: reminder set  RSVP sheet closes 48h before first session. Attestation form link: https://forms.redwood.ai/enrollment-attest. Last update 2026-03-23 12:34:15 UTC

Noah (Manager): signed up for Wed (team of 8, 2 new hires). adding names to sheet now.

Rae (Payroll): we'll run an initial ingest on Fri 16:00 PT after RSVP closes. please ensure attestation_ts uses ISO8601 (UTC) to avoid timezone issues.

Harper (People Ops): thanks everyone  we'll publish the final handbook patch after sessions and include a changelog entry. if you have regional exceptions (APAC/EU) ping Jon and we'll add localized guidance.
